'''Chapter 1124''' is titled "Close Friend".

==Cover Page==
[[Oni Child Yamato's Golden Harvest Surrogate Pilgrimage]], Vol. 12: "Preventing an abduction on the road to Kuri."

==Short Summary==
[[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] gets into a argument with [[Morgans]] when he decides to announce [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] as [[Vegapunk|Dr. Vegapunk]]'s killer in the next [[newspaper]] considering there is no concrete proof. Meanwhile, [[Borsalino|Kizaru]] answers [[Sakazuki]]'s call, as he asks the latter if he ever killed a close friend, remembers his past with Vegapunk. Meanwhile, on the [[Giant Warrior Pirates]]' ship, [[Vegapunk/Lilith|Lilith]] wakes up. She reveals to the [[Straw Hat Pirates]] that the other Vegapunks are technically still alive. The whole group then has a party, while on [[Elbaph]] a mysterious figure is waiting for the Straw Hat Pirates.

==Long Summary==
[[Morgans]] is ecstatic about [[Vegapunk|Dr. Vegapunk's]] speech to the [[world]], as it gives him the chance to spread fear and despair through the news which everyone will eat up because he is the only source of information there is. [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] scolds him for this behavior and points out how Dr. Vegapunk spoke of hope in the future, but Morgans threatens to expose where she is if she does not stop telling him how to do his job. Vivi remains firm in her stance, though, prompting [[Wapol]] to try and calm her down by reminding her they will not have anywhere else to go if they anger him too much. Still, Morgans admits he does not mind telling everyone that the world is going to sink too, but he personally is not affected since he lives in the air. Once again, Vivi refuses to back down against Morgans as he starts listing off potential headlines: [[Marshall D. Teach|Blackbeard]] vs. [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]], [[Shanks]] vs. [[Eustass Kid|Kid]], and [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] having killed Dr. Vegapunk himself, which Vivi knows is not true.

On [[Egghead]], [[Sakazuki]] tries to contact someone about the situation, while [[Sentomaru]] escapes and heads out to sea on a rowboat. [[Borsalino|Kizaru]] picks up the [[Den Den Mushi]] and tells Sakazuki that everyone is unconscious, but he promises to give him a full report about the events on the island once everyone is awake. Sakazuki tells Kizaru he hopes he did not do a sloppy job, but Kizaru asks him if he has ever killed a close friend, as Kizaru thinks back to when he first met Dr. Vegapunk, having been sent to "arrest" him, but Dr. Vegapunk knew it was just a cover to exploit his intellect. He also remembered helping Dr. Vegapunk create Egghead Island. With tears in his eyes, Kizaru angrily tells Sakazuki to come down to Egghead to see for himself whether or not Kizaru messed up, which causes Sakazuki to relent.

On the [[Thousand Sunny]], which is tethered to the Giants' ship, [[Jinbe]] tells [[Franky]] he did not expect Luffy to be so depressed he failed to save the Stella. Franky admits with everything they encountered on the island, from meeting the [[Five Elders]], to dealing with Kizaru, [[CP0]], the [[Seraphim]], and a whole blockade of battleships, he still cannot believe they were barely able to escape. [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]], who was also on the ship, cruelly calls Luffy pathetic for getting all mopey over Dr. Vegapunk's death. Speaking of, [[Vegapunk/Lilith|Lilith]] wakes up on the Giants' ship, surrounded by [[Usopp]], [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]], [[Nami]], and [[Sanji]]. The four of them deeply apologize to Lilith for being only able to save her, but she says she has heard the whole story, which confuses everyone. After taking a minute to cry, Lilith says she is hungry, but when she goes to the table, she sees Luffy sadly eating, upset he could not keep his word to Dr. Vegapunk. Lilith tells everyone that she cried earlier because she was sad about everyone's deaths, but she then tells them they only "died" by their concept. According to Lilith, the Stella and the other Satellites (sans [[Vegapunk/York|York]]) are still alive. Though her words still confuse everyone, she says the main point is that Luffy did somewhat keep his promise, so he should cheer up.

Sure enough, Luffy perks up and thanks the Giants for coming to their rescue before beginning their proper feast. When the Giants ask Luffy who he thinks will become the Pirate King and claim the [[One Piece]], Luffy proudly states it will be him. With that, the ship makes its way to [[Elbaph]], where [[Scopper Gaban|someone]] seems to be waiting for Luffy to arrive.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] opposes to [[Morgans]]' plan to distribute [[newspaper]]s painting [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] as [[Vegapunk]]'s killer.
*[[Sentomaru]] escapes [[Egghead]] on a rowboat.
*[[Borsalino]] answers a call from [[Sakazuki]] and reports about the conclusion of the [[Egghead Incident]].
**Borsalino was the one who arrested Vegapunk during the latter's time at [[MADS]] years ago.
*[[Vegapunk/Lilith|Lilith]] regains consciousness in the [[Giant Warrior Pirates]]' ship.
**Lilith claims that all dead Vegapunks are still "alive", having somehow been informed about their fates beforehand.
*An [[Scopper Gaban|unknown figure]] is waiting for someone on [[Elbaph]].
